map_note: County boards' own data runs ahead of the state's daily dashboard; where a county's figure is higher, it is used. Butler, Clermont, Crawford, Franklin, Hamilton, Hancock, Henry and Morrow publish voter-level lists that include each voter's party, so their party splits are used too. Cuyahoga reports totals only, so the extra ballots count in totals but not party shares. Butler (as of 2026-10-30 03:01): mail returned 13,152 (state 12,529); early in person 35,425 (state 32,045); ballots sent 16,972 (state 16,969). Clermont (as of 2026-10-30 06:12): mail returned 11,222 (state 10,808); early in person 16,010 (state 14,676). Crawford (as of 2026-10-29 15:38): mail returned 1,829 (state 1,717); early in person 3,063 (state 2,903). Cuyahoga (as of 2026-10-29 19:42): mail returned 96,153 (state 90,792); early in person 43,507 (state 39,720). Franklin (as of 2026-10-30 00:12): mail returned 63,982 (state 61,091); early in person 78,343 (state 70,904); ballots sent 82,958 (state 82,914). Hamilton (as of 2026-10-28 21:44): early in person 57,944 (state 56,600). Hancock: mail returned 2,604 (state 2,449); early in person 8,153 (state 7,827). Henry (as of 2026-10-27 16:58): early in person 2,953 (state 2,726). Morrow (as of 2026-10-29 18:33): mail returned 1,209 (state 1,159); early in person 2,996 (state 2,793).
